ca_cert.description: The CA certificate, as PEM, or an op:// 1Password reference to it.

ca_key.description: The CA's private key, as a PKCS#8 PEM, or an op:// 1Password reference to it. Only hostname issue and zone issue read it.

cloudflare_api_token.description: The Cloudflare API token, or an op:// 1Password reference to it. When neither the profile nor the top level sets one, aopctl uses CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

cloudflare_zone_id.description: The zone ID of every hostname and zone command run without --zone, or an op:// 1Password reference to it.

hostnames.description: Every hostname the CA serves, across all zones. A profile's list replaces the top-level one.
